# Economy and raids

`game.economy` reads silver, wealth and prices, lists traders and their stock and calls orbital traders. `game.raids` lists raid strategies and arrival modes and sends raids. The kits are Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md). Sending gifts to a faction is `game.factions.send_gift`.

```lua
print("Silver:", game.economy.silver(), "Wealth:", game.economy.wealth().total)

-- Friendly allies send help when a raid arrives
game.events.on("incident.fired", function(e)
  if e.incident == "RaidEnemy" then
    for _, f in ipairs(game.factions.allies(game.factions.player())) do
      game.raids.fire({ faction = f, points = 400 })
    end
  end
end)
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.economy.silver` | `h?` | `integer` | Silver the colony holds on a map, the current map by default. |
| `game.economy.wealth` | `h?` | `RimWealth` | Colony wealth split into items, buildings, pawns and floors. |
| `game.economy.price` | `def?, stuff?, thing?` | `RimPrice` | Market value of a def (with a material) or a thing, with rough trade prices. |
| `game.economy.give_silver` | `amount, h?` | `integer` | Drops silver by pod next to the colony. |
| `game.economy.trader_kinds` |  | `RimTraderKind[]` | Every trader kind def. |
| `game.economy.ships` | `h?` | `RimShipInfo[]` | Passing ships and orbital traders. |
| `game.economy.stock` | `settlement?, ship?, h?` | `RimStockItem[]` | Goods of a settlement, or of an orbital trader by index. |
| `game.economy.call_trader` | `h?` | `boolean` | Calls an orbital trader. |
| `game.raids.strategies` |  | `RimRaidStrategy[]` | Every raid strategy def. |
| `game.raids.arrival_modes` |  | `RimArrivalMode[]` | Every way a raid can arrive. |
| `game.raids.can_fire` | `opts?, h?` | `boolean` | Whether a raid with these options could fire now. |
| `game.raids.fire` | `opts?, h?` | `boolean` | Sends a raid at a map. |
